review_scope: Bounded Digital Edge CGK2 candidate identity review. No new site, project, geometry or selected evidence is proposed. Four search queries and public reads were sufficient to establish the duplicate-campus exclusion; no denied or gated route was retried.

candidate.name: Digital Edge CGK2
candidate.identity_finding: The operator-authored CGK2 post, embedded in a public Emmeline Tang repost, expressly places CGK2 in Digital Edge's 500 MW CGK campus at GIIC Cikarang. The existing selected CGK1 source identifies CGK1 as the first building in that same 500 MW GIIC/Bekasi campus and forecasts the second building for Q1 2027. CGK2 is another building of the represented campus, not a distinct physical site. BDx CGK2 and downtown EDGE1/EDGE2 are separate identities and were not merged.
candidate.physical_observation_finding: The embedded Digital Edge Indonesia post reports successful structural topping out of CGK2 and describes readiness for service in Q1 2027 as a future target. This is a physical-work lead, not evidence of completion or operation. The repost's captured JSON-LD datePublished is 2026-08-19T01:00:06.480Z; this is the repost publication date, not an independently verified original operator-post or topping-out event date. The relative age and the phrase This week are not converted into an absolute observation day.
candidate.remaining_project_evidence_gates: If a future task needs an additional CGK2 project row within the existing campus, obtain the original operator permalink and absolute physical-observation date, an exact project/campus locator meeting the current contract, and authoritative completion/cancellation successor closure. Resolving these gates cannot add a distinct site.

successor_screen.result: The bounded search returned no results. The captured operator company page presents only its latest ten posts, none containing the target topping-out post. This is not an exhaustive completion/cancellation clearance. No further searches were required for the duplicate-campus decision.

inherited_geometry_review_finding.finding: The reviewed release inherits a polygon explicitly described as the entire GIIC host estate, not the CGK campus boundary, parcel, project footprint or building footprint. This is an explicit review finding about inherited data, not a baseline correction or a new geometry proposal; frozen inputs and selected release records were not changed.
